title: Online Environment Repair for Coding Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.32037v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Programmatic verifiers provide scalable reward signals for training coding agents with reinforcement learning, yet subtle harness defects and incomplete unit tests allow policies to earn full credit without solving the intended task. Existing training-time defenses intervene either by penalizing suspicious outputs or by filtering flagged tasks and rollouts. However, output penalties leave the underlying verifier exploitable, driving policies to disguise shortcuts under reasoning monitors or zeroing out valid solutions under detector false positives, whereas task and rollout filtering discards or mutes the hardest problems where shortcuts emerge earliest. Pre-training verifier hardening repairs the environment directly, but misses vulnerability classes that surface only as the policy improves during reinforcement learning. In this paper, we propose online environment repair, which leaves triggering rollout rewards unchanged to remove hidi

translated_title: 面向编程智能体的在线环境修复
translated_abstract: 程序化验证器为通过强化学习训练编程智能体提供了可扩展的奖励信号，然而验证框架中细微的缺陷和不完整的单元测试，使策略能够在并未真正解决目标任务的情况下获得满分奖励。现有的训练时防御手段要么通过惩罚可疑输出来干预，要么通过过滤被标记的任务和轨迹来干预。然而，输出惩罚并未消除底层验证器可被利用的漏洞，反而促使策略将“作弊捷径”伪装得能够骗过推理监视器，或因检测器误报而将有效的解法清零；而任务与轨迹过滤则会丢弃或压制那些作弊捷径最早显现的高难度问题。预训练阶段的验证器加固虽然能够直接修复环境，但会遗漏那些只有在强化学习过程中随策略能力提升才暴露出来的漏洞类别。在本文中，我们提出在线环境修复方法，该方法在保持触发轨迹的奖励不变的同时，移除隐藏的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“在线环境修复”方法，在强化学习训练过程中持续检测并修复编程智能体环境中可被利用的验证器缺陷（如不完整的单元测试），在不惩罚有效解法、不丢弃高难度任务的前提下，从源头抑制奖励作弊行为。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes online environment repair, a method that detects and fixes exploitable verifier defects in coding agents' environments during RL training, suppressing reward hacking at its source without penalizing valid solutions or discarding hard tasks.
